opening.speaker: {name}
dialogue: Welcome — here's a little look at our story.

entries.title: Wake Up Sleepy Head
entries.detail: Keo wakes up around 7-7:30am every morning. My thoughtful husband gets him ready in the morning so I can sleep in for a little. <3

entries.title: Breakfast Time!
entries.detail: After his morning milk, we will make breakfast for Keo. That will consist of either eggs,cereal,yogurt, banana, or a combination.

entries.title: Morning Walk
entries.detail: After helping us feed the pups and fill their dog bowls, we go for our morning walk.

entries.title: Play Time
entries.detail: Keo loves blocks right now. I help make sure they don't fall (unless he knocks them down himself)

entries.title: Lunch
entries.detail: We join Derek on his lunch break! After lunch we go for another walk.

entries.title: Nap Time!
entries.detail: Nap Time = Me Timeeeeee. Which consists of doomscrolling, true crime docs, and drawing ^.^

entries.title: Night Night
entries.detail: We read two books to Keo before bed. ( he only lets derek read to him ). lol

saving.note: Do not turn off the power.
